name: pele_sulphur_ring
theme: a planetary slice that never leaves Jupiter's volcanic moon Io, a YELLOW world and not a storm planet: the mustard globe from orbit with Jupiter's banded disc as backdrop only; the rust-red ring of fallen sulphur laid about the Pele vent; the umbrella plume arching over a glowing lava-lake rim and raining back down; sulphur frost crystals on black lava glass; and the eight-atom sulphur crown molecule stacked in crystal ranks. Math personality: rings and umbrellas, fallout laid in rings about a point, a fountain arching over and falling back along ballistic arcs. Seam: the puckered eight-atom crown rhymes back to the red ring deposit about Pele seen from orbit, a ring at two scales. Palette family: Io sulphur & caldera black. Slow, monumental pace.
music_theme: a smouldering volcanic moon under a giant planet: slow heavy pulses like distant eruptions, a vast fountain rising and falling back, patient, monumental, faintly sulphurous heat

registers.name: io_globe
registers.palette: mustard-sulphur globe, coal-black calderas, rust-red ring deposit, cream-and-tan banded backdrop, ink-black void
registers.scene: Jupiter's moon Io seen whole from orbit, a mustard-yellow sulphur globe pocked with coal-black calderas, one rust-red ring of fallen sulphur hundreds of kilometres wide laid about a single dark vent on its face, ochre and tawny plains between, Jupiter's banded cream-and-tan disc looming huge behind it in an ink-black void
registers.loop_target: the mustard-yellow globe of Io pocked with black calderas

registers.name: pele_ring
registers.palette: rust-red and brick ring of fallout, mustard and ochre plains, coal-black caldera floor, one ember-orange glint
registers.scene: the volcanic plains of Io seen from high orbit, the view tilting toward the curved horizon, a vast rust-red ring of fallen sulphur laid in a perfect band about one coal-black caldera, brick-red and orange streaks fanning outward through it, mustard and ochre plains beyond pocked with smaller black calderas, an ember-orange glint at the caldera's heart, the ink-black sky past the horizon

registers.name: pele_plume
registers.palette: ember-orange lava rim, coal-black lake crust, sulphur-cream umbrella plume, mustard frost crust, ink-black sky
registers.scene: the Pele caldera seen low and oblique over its rim, a horseshoe of incandescent ember-orange lava glowing along the edge of a coal-black lake crust, a colossal umbrella plume arching over the horizon in sulphur-cream curtains and curving back down in ballistic arcs onto the plain, a mustard-yellow frost crust coating the black ground beyond the rim, ink-black sky with Jupiter's tan crescent low behind

registers.name: sulphur_frost
registers.palette: lemon and amber sulphur needles, frost-white rosettes, glossy coal-black lava glass, faint ember-orange glow
registers.scene: a frost garden of sulphur crystals on glossy coal-black lava glass, lemon-yellow and amber needles bristling in tufts, stubby faceted yellow prisms and frost-white rosettes crowded among them, every facet glinting, a faint ember-orange glow reflected low in the black glass

registers.name: sulphur_octet
registers.palette: amber and lemon-yellow spheres, ochre bonds, deep coal-black depth, ember-orange rim light
registers.scene: countless puckered rings of eight glossy amber spheres stacked in crystal ranks, each ring zig-zagging up and down sphere by sphere, joined by short ochre bonds, rank after rank of rings receding into coal-black depth, ember-orange light along their rims

stage.element: a sulphur atom, a glossy amber globe mottled with lemon-yellow vents and ochre plains, one coal-black pit, ember-orange light along its rim
